alignments.note: γάρ → For, fronted by the ASV.
πρό → before.
Attributive demonstrative supplies the English determiner.
The demonstrative already occupies the determiner slot, so the article realizes nothing (rule 38).
ἡμερῶν → days.
Compound ἀνέστη → rose up; the particle realizes the preverb ἀνα- and rides inside the verb's unit, headed on the verb word (rule 106).
Name → Theudas.
λέγων rendered by the phrasal giving … out, discontinuous under rule 15 around the expressed reflexive; out is the English verb's own particle, not a separate source word's.
ἑαυτόν → himself. The infinitive's subject is expressed here, so rule 74's supplied-subject case does not arise.
Infinitive with its rule 7 marker to, headed on the lexical verb.
τινα → somebody.
Relative pronoun with its case preposition to riding along (rule 21).
Anarthrous ἀριθμός with the supplied indefinite as a rule 51 helper on the noun. The variant covering this token is underdetermined and the projection's base is compatible.
Genitive ἀνδρῶν rendered of men, the case preposition staying with the noun since no article stands to anchor it (rule 21).
Approximative ὡς → about.

One Greek numeral lexeme rendered by two English words; headed on hundred, the word realizing the -κόσιοι element that carries the magnitude, with four as its multiplier. Rule 29 does not apply, there being only one source token and no juncture.

Greek passive rendered by an English reflexive; themselves is the verb's own rule 7 helper, headed on the lexical verb. The variant covering this token is underdetermined and the projection's base is compatible.
Relative ὅς → who.
Passive with its auxiliary; rule 9 heads on the lexical verb slain.
Expressed καί → and.
πάντες → all.
ὅσοι → as many as as one correlative expression, headed on the quantity word many rather than on either as.
ἐπείθοντο → obeyed.
Dative αὐτῷ → him, the English verb taking a bare object.
Passive with its auxiliary, headed on the lexical verb.
Expressed καί → and.
ἐγένοντο → came.
εἰς → to. The ASV spreads the phrase over two words that each answer to a token, so rules 45 and 94 do not join the pair.
οὐδέν → nought; no other negator stands in the clause, so rules 41 and 59 are not in question.

review_notes: All 29 source and 40 target IDs partitioned exactly once.
Both variant units are underdetermined with the projection's base among the compatible readings, so no rule 97 addition arises.

The ASV's giving himself out to be somebody splits λέγων from the expressed reflexive ἑαυτόν; the alternative of folding himself into λέγων's unit was rejected because ἑαυτόν is an expressed source token with its own English word.
